acqinfo.head: Immediate Source of Acquisition note
acqinfo.p: (Accession 7) The photographs of Richard M. Pearce were deposited with The Rockefeller Foundation Archives in June 1967 by Mrs. Richard M. Pearce.
(Accession 49) The Richard M. Pearce Collection was given to The Rockefeller Foundation Archives on August 15, 1974 by Miss Agnes Pearce of Dorset, Vemont. There are no restrictions.

accessrestrict.head: Conditions Governing Access
accessrestrict.p: Open for research. Brittle or damaged items are available at the discretion of RAC.

scopecontent.head: Scope and Contents
scopecontent.p: The Richard M. Pearce collection is comprised of a small selection of photographs, correspondence, honors, and a scrapbook.

did.unittitle: Richard Mills Pearce Scrapbook - Aeterna Vigilantia

scopecontent.head: Scope and Contents
scopecontent.p: Photographs primarily consists of portrait and group photographs featuring Richard Pearce. They show Pearce at dinners and on site visits in Brazil, Chile, Argentina, Germany, and Puerto Rico. The photos originate from different periods of Pearce's career, including his time as Director of the Rockefeller Foundation's Division of Medical Sciences.

did.physdesc: 20 still images: 20 photograph prints. Photos are mounted and most have captions.
